argv: sdk/sdk-worker.js=Bound separately and more precisely as workerSha256: the copy that actually runs is the one inside the profile.
reader-shell/reader-session.js=The R6 reader shell. Not in the editor page import graph; only reader-shell/tile-scheduler.js is.
reader-shell/state-machine.js=The reader shell own state machine, not the editor. Not in the editor page import graph.

sdk/v23-diagnostic-worker-tail.js=Private ABI5 diagnostic tail concatenated only into e2-editor-v23-diag; its resulting profile worker is separately bound by workerSha256. Not imported by the product page.

sdk/v23-diagnostic-r2-worker-tail.js=Private ABI5 diagnostic tail concatenated only into e2-editor-v23-diag-r2; its resulting profile worker is separately bound by workerSha256. Not imported by the product page.
sdk/v23-feature-worker.js=Source of the ABI6 e2-editor-v23 profile worker, separately bound by workerSha256. The product creates that profile worker by URL; this source is not a page import.

sdk/v24-feature-worker.js=Source of the ABI6 e2-editor-v24 profile worker (typed-insert route), separately bound by the profile manifest workerSha256 (41041fe7...) and copied into dist/profiles/e2-editor-v24; the product page creates its worker from the profile, never from this path (spec SPEC-M3-link-batch-v24 4.4, 15).
